setup_multilingual_masked_lm_task: setup a multilingual masked language model task from data paths and dictionary using setup_task
load_multilingual_dataset: load a multilingual dataset split with token masking and language-aware resampling via load_dataset
configure_masking_args: configure masking arguments like mask-prob, leave-unmasked-prob, and random-token-prob via add_args
build_inference_dataset: build a dataset for inference from source tokens and lengths using build_dataset_for_inference
enable_whole_word_masking: enable whole word masking using BPE boundaries via the mask-whole-words argument
